verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms LangGraph nodes can be arbitrary functions and that custom tool-handling logic (not just prebuilt LangChain tools) is supported, implying developers can define custom tools, but there is no docs example showing a typed tool decorator or minimal-code tool definition pattern. Missing for 10: explicit tool-definition API/decorator example, type-annotation support, and a concrete few-line code sample demonstrating an agent wired to typed custom tools.
